critical_issues.description: world_activity.json shows Year 127 Day 365 while timeline.json and history.json show Year 127 Day 43.
Citizen projects and fashion work exist but are not reflected in world_activity.json.
Citizens can learn and master additional Trinity paths, but this rule is not documented in canon.
Citizens can think, learn, create, build relationships and work on projects simultaneously, but this is not documented.
Mistakes, corrections and lessons should influence future decisions but this rule is not formally documented.
Properties exist for Ariel and Nia, but not yet for Luca and Amara.
Western Apartment exists in worldstate.json but is not defined in properties.json.
Some files use first names only while others use full names.
The relationship between known citizens and discovered citizens is not clearly defined.
world_tick.json defines the heartbeat process but no runtime currently executes it.
